newsitem.title: USA: Teleport stock drops; uncertainty on company's stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Teleport stock drops; uncertainty on company's stock offering.

text.p: The stock of Teleport Communications Group Inc. dropped sharply Wednesday after the phone line provider said it would consider offering common stock and debt securities in the second quarter.
Teleport lost $3.125 to $23.75 on the Nasdaq market.

One analyst, who declined to be identified, said there was some investor uncertainty after the announcement, which was made Monday, because Teleport had not yet determined how much additional securities would be sold.
Teleport said, however, that adverse changes in market conditions could cause it to delay or abandon its plans for an offering.
